description: List all packet capture sessions within the specified resource group.

params.description: The name of the Network Watcher resource.
params.name: networkWatcherName

params.description: The name of the resource group.
params.name: resourceGroupName

params.description: The subscription credentials which uniquely identify the Microsoft Azure subscription. The subscription ID forms part of the URI for every service call.
params.name: subscriptionId

props.description: Information about packet capture sessions.
A unique read-only string that changes whenever the resource is updated.
props.name: etag

props.description: ID of the packet capture operation.
props.name: id

props.description: Name of the packet capture session.
props.name: name

props.description: Properties of the packet capture result.
props.name: properties

props.description: Number of bytes captured per packet, the remaining bytes are truncated.
props.name: bytesToCapturePerPacket

props.description: The capture setting holds the 'FileCount', 'FileSizeInBytes', 'SessionTimeLimitInSeconds' values.
props.name: captureSettings

props.description: Number of file count. Default value of count is 10 and maximum number is 10000.
props.name: fileCount

props.description: Number of bytes captured per packet. Default value in bytes 104857600 (100MB) and maximum in bytes 4294967295 (4GB).
props.name: fileSizeInBytes

props.description: Maximum duration of the capture session in seconds is 604800s (7 days) for a file. Default value in second 86400s (1 day).
props.name: sessionTimeLimitInSeconds

props.description: This continuous capture is a nullable boolean, which can hold 'null', 'true' or 'false' value. If we do not pass this parameter, it would be consider as 'null', default value is 'null'.
props.name: continuousCapture

props.description: A list of packet capture filters.

Local IP Address to be filtered on. Notation: "127.0.0.1" for single address entry. "127.0.0.1-127.0.0.255" for range. "127.0.0.1;127.0.0.5"? for multiple entries. Multiple ranges not currently supported. Mixing ranges with multiple entries not currently supported. Default = null.
props.name: localIPAddress

props.description: Local port to be filtered on. Notation: "80" for single port entry."80-85" for range. "80;443;" for multiple entries. Multiple ranges not currently supported. Mixing ranges with multiple entries not currently supported. Default = null.
props.name: localPort

props.description: Protocol to be filtered on.
props.name: protocol

props.description: Local IP Address to be filtered on. Notation: "127.0.0.1" for single address entry. "127.0.0.1-127.0.0.255" for range. "127.0.0.1;127.0.0.5;" for multiple entries. Multiple ranges not currently supported. Mixing ranges with multiple entries not currently supported. Default = null.
props.name: remoteIPAddress

props.description: Remote port to be filtered on. Notation: "80" for single port entry."80-85" for range. "80;443;" for multiple entries. Multiple ranges not currently supported. Mixing ranges with multiple entries not currently supported. Default = null.
props.name: remotePort
filters

props.description: The provisioning state of the packet capture session.
props.name: provisioningState

props.description: A list of AzureVMSS instances which can be included or excluded to run packet capture. If both included and excluded are empty, then the packet capture will run on all instances of AzureVMSS.
props.name: scope

props.description: List of AzureVMSS instances which has to be excluded from the AzureVMSS from running packet capture.
props.name: exclude

props.description: List of AzureVMSS instances to run packet capture on.
props.name: include

props.description: The storage location for a packet capture session.
props.name: storageLocation

props.description: This path is invalid if 'Continuous Capture' is provided with 'true' or 'false'. A valid local path on the targeting VM. Must include the name of the capture file (*.cap). For linux virtual machine it must start with /var/captures. Required if no storage ID is provided, otherwise optional.
props.name: filePath

props.description: This path is valid if 'Continuous Capture' is provided with 'true' or 'false' and required if no storage ID is provided, otherwise optional. Must include the name of the capture file (*.cap). For linux virtual machine it must start with /var/captures.
props.name: localPath

props.description: The ID of the storage account to save the packet capture session. Required if no localPath or filePath is provided.
props.name: storageId

props.description: The URI of the storage path to save the packet capture. Must be a well-formed URI describing the location to save the packet capture.
props.name: storagePath

props.description: The ID of the targeted resource, only AzureVM and AzureVMSS as target type are currently supported.
props.name: target

props.description: Target type of the resource provided.
props.name: targetType

props.description: Maximum duration of the capture session in seconds.
props.name: timeLimitInSeconds

props.description: Maximum size of the capture output.
props.name: totalBytesPerSession
